property.name: content
property.description: Kafka client JAAS config. Uses keytab-based authentication (replacing ticket-cache) so unattended client-only hosts can authenticate after Ambari distributes credentials via the KAFKA_CLIENT Kerberos identity. Applies to all hosts on config refresh, including brokers. Clusters that relied on interactive ticket-cache authentication for Kafka CLI tools must verify keytabs are distributed to client hosts after upgrade; see ambari-server/docs/security/kerberos/kerberos_descriptor.md.
